subject: general
question: Which of the following Directive Principles is mentioned in Article 44 of the Constitution of India?

options.text: Organisation of agriculture and animal husbandry
Uniform civil code for the citizens
Equal justice and free legal aid

solution:
The correct answer is __**Uniform civil code for the citizens**__.

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] __Key Points__

 
• Article 44 of the Indian Constitution is a part of the Directive Principles of State Policy (DPSP) and emphasizes the **implementation of a Uniform Civil Code (UCC) across the country**.
 
• The Uniform Civil Code aims to replace personal laws based on the scriptures and customs of various religious communities with a **common set of secular laws** governing marriage, divorce, inheritance, and
